$Comment: The spot the Headless Horseman rides in from on the hard ride, in the saddle (Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_Mounted_HM): Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_Marker's twin, standing in his hard graveyard's prefab beside his hard fight's own entity. ManualTrigger means it never spawns him on its own: only his hard fight's script raises him, when players come near, and only while his last spawn is gone. RealtimeRespawn and RealtimeRespawnTime are the respawn form every marker must write; a marker that only fires on request never reads them. DeactivationDistance and DeactivationTime are wide so he is never packed back into the marker mid-fight.
